name: Lead
what_is: A toxic heavy metal environmental contaminant causing neurological and reproductive damage.
why_botia: Reproductive toxicant that can delay pubertal development in girls and cross the placenta.
can_1: Flag food types historically prone to lead contamination.
can_2: Provide safety context on blood-lead levels and prenatal susceptibility.

cannot_2: Determine if lead migrated from packaging materials.
